units.source_text: 肮脏的雾气遮住了视线。

en.t: A dirty mist blocked his view.

units.source_text: 他一翻身，只听到沙沙干燥的纸张声音，

en.t: When he turned over, he heard only the dry rustle of paper,

units.source_text: 原来是一张摊开的报纸，盖在了他的脸上。

en.t: and found that an open newspaper was lying over his face.
Damn it, he had fallen asleep again!
... He flung it off at once,

units.source_text: 覆盖在报纸表面的沙子洒落了下来。

en.t: and the sand covering the surface of the newspaper spilled down.

units.source_text: 从那个量来估计，好像已经过了相当长的时间了。

en.t: Judging from the amount of it, quite a long time seemed to have passed.

units.source_text: 太阳光从墙壁的缝隙里射进来，

en.t: Sunlight was streaming in through the cracks in the wall,

units.source_text: 它那位置也报告说眼下已接近正午。

en.t: and its position showed that it was already nearly noon.

units.source_text: 更令人奇怪的，这气味是怎么回事呢？

en.t: Even stranger, what was this smell?
Was it the smell of fresh ink?

units.source_text: ……他心里想着“哪儿可能”，可还是往日期栏上扫了一眼。

en.t: ... Thinking to himself, "That cannot be," he still glanced over at the date column.

units.source_text: 十六日、星期三……还真是今天的报纸！

en.t: The sixteenth, Wednesday... it really was today's newspaper!

units.source_text: 简直不敢相信，但是事实。

en.t: It was almost impossible to believe, but it was true.

units.source_text: 原来是女人顺从了他的希望呐。

en.t: So the woman had granted his wish after all.
